responsibility: Loads and validates the reconstruction blueprint, exposes it as operational input, and is the canonical execution-authorization basis for each selected module.
failure_boundary: fail_closed — a manifest that is missing a section, carries an unknown status, selects an uncontracted module, carries a literal dependency order or gives a selected module no non-blank evidence_basis is refused, and a manifest that disagrees with the contracts raises a recorded evidence conflict
recovery_behavior: Stateless loader; the manifest and contracts on disk are the only inputs, so a fresh load fully restores the blueprint after any interruption
replacement_contract: A replacement must expose current_stage, stages, selected modules with reconstruction_status and a non-empty evidence_basis, a derived dependency order, a baseline_hash covering manifest and contracts together, and a canonical authorization basis per module that returns nothing rather than a weak or inferred basis
evidence_produced: manifest_hash over the exact manifest bytes
baseline_hash over manifest plus contract registry
the canonical authorization basis of a selected module, or none
BlueprintError or EvidenceConflict detail naming the refused section
